info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Deposit Lending By Leasing Id-spec
info.description: This API allows businesses to update deposit lending details associated with a specific leasing ID. Through a PATCH request, developers can modify key attributes, ensuring that the lending information is current and accurate. This functionality is essential for financial institutions and service providers who manage leasing contracts and need to respond to changes promptly. Typical consumers include banking applications and leasing management systems that require an efficient way to manage lending details.
